name: orb_momentum_5s_2
author: adapted from QuantGen_Subagent_5
thesis: The opening 15-30 minutes represent overnight information assimilation. A breakout beyond this range indicates a directional institutional order flow imbalance. It exists because large orders cannot be executed all at once and create sustained trends.
mechanism: The opening range concentrates pending orders and stop-losses on both sides. When price breaches the range boundary, stop-loss orders from wrong-side participants cascade, amplifying the move. Breakout-following algorithms detect the breach and add momentum, creating a self-reinforcing move that typically persists for 60-180 seconds before the order book absorbs the flow.

conditions: close > orb_high AND close > vwap AND volume > SMA(volume, 30)
close < orb_low AND close < vwap AND volume > SMA(volume, 30)

weaknesses: Difficult to execute near the breakout point due to fast moves
Decays rapidly in low VIX regimes
prior_art: Opening Range Breakout (ORB) by Tony Crabel
adaptation_notes: Converted from 15min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 180x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; stop/target recalibration for 5-second timeframe. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
